svg.title: Gazebo: isometric
svg.desc: Isometric of an octagonal garden pavilion: a raised platform with an entrance step, eight slender posts linked by low railings and brackets, and a bell-shaped roof with flared eaves rising to a finial. Source: Original drawing by Project Exodus from the standard geometric construction of this form; no external drawing reproduced.

g.text: SOURCE: Original drawing by Project Exodus from the standard geometric
construction of this form; no external drawing reproduced.
